questions.q: What does the model see for a ConditioningSetArea prompt?
options: The whole latent, then a mask
Only the cropped box of latent
questions.answer: Only the cropped box of latent
questions.why: get_area_and_mult narrows input_x to the area.

questions.q: A box at strength 3 over a whole-picture prompt at strength 1 gets what share at its centre?
questions.why: 3 / (3 + 1), from sum of answer times weight over sum of weights.

questions.q: What happens in a cell no entry covers?
questions.why: out_conds starts at zero, and out_counts at 1e-37, so the division gives 0.

questions.q: Your box is alone over its cells. What does strength 5 do?
questions.why: The lab shows 1.0 at both strengths.

questions.q: How many predictions per step for one box, one whole prompt and one negative at cfg 7?
questions.why: The negative gets a same-area copy from create_cond_with_same_area_if_none.

questions.q: Why might ConditioningSetArea land in the wrong place on FLUX.2?
questions.why: The tuple uses // 8. Prefer ConditioningSetAreaPercentage on other latent scales.
